title: Common-Box
description: When you achieve peak storage efficiency
body:
Simple resource pack that replaces every shulker-related textures with cardboard-themed ones!

Indicators on the edges of the box gives you the box color so you don't get confused

Textures heavily inspired by [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fabric)'s
